settings.title: Settings
settings.navBarHint: Choose the pages shown around the + button on your phone. Everything else is under More. Saved on this device.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hint: Your own reminders (not shared with the household). Times are Israel time.
reminders.clampHint: Shorter months use their last day.
reminders.reviewHint: You get one notice when last month’s review becomes available.
reminders.reviewWhen: Once a month, when it is ready
reminders.pushUnavailable: Notifications are not set up on this server, so reminders appear in the app only (on the Overview page).
reminders.enablePush: Turn on notifications on this device
reminders.testNone: No device received it. Turn notifications on first.

device.on: Notifications are on for this device.
device.off: Notifications are off on this device. Reminders still appear on the Overview page.
device.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser or phone settings.
device.install: On iPhone, add the app to the Home Screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen), open it from there, then turn notifications on.
device.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Reminders appear on the Overview page.

reminders.cardImportBody: Download the latest statement from your bank and import it.
reminders.cardDailyBody: Anything you paid today? It takes a few seconds.

pwa.installBody: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, to open the app like any other app.
pwa.offlineBody: Your financial data is never stored on this device, so it needs a connection.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.forbidden_role: Your role in this household can't do that.
errors.csrf: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invite_invalid: This link is invalid, already used or expired.
errors.passkey_failed: The passkey couldn't be verified. Try again.
errors.challenge_expired: That took too long. Try again.
errors.unknown_passkey: This passkey isn't registered here. Use an invite or recovery link.
errors.last_owner: A household needs at least one owner.
errors.last_passkey: You can't remove your only passkey.
errors.wrong_host: Open the app from its main address.
errors.challenge_mismatch: The link changed during setup. Open it again.
errors.invite_wrong_kind: This link can't be used that way.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.passkey_cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled or isn't available on this device.
errors.split_sum_mismatch: The split lines must add up exactly to the transaction amount.
errors.split_min_lines: A split needs at least two lines.
errors.imported_readonly: Imported details can't be changed; you can set the category and notes.
errors.name_taken_hidden: A hidden category of another type already has this name. Restore it from “Show hidden” or choose another name.
errors.no_history: Hiding unused categories needs transactions from at least two months.
errors.system_category: This built-in category can't be removed.
errors.date_in_future: The date can't be in the future.
errors.too_many_rows: Too many rows in one request.
errors.row_invalid: A row in the file is invalid.
errors.not_expense_category: Only expense categories can have a budget.
errors.ai_disabled: AI is turned off for this household.
errors.ai_rate_limited: Today's AI limit has been reached.
errors.ai_bad_output: The AI reply couldn't be used.
errors.ai_timeout: The AI took too long to answer.
errors.recovery_needs_admin: This person also uses Money Money Money elsewhere (or is the administrator). Ask the administrator for a recovery link.
errors.registration_failed: The account couldn't be created. Please try again with the same link.
errors.demo_read_only: The tour shows demo data, which can’t be changed.
errors.too_many_reminders: You have reached the maximum number of reminders.
errors.too_many_devices: Too many devices have notifications on. Remove one first.
errors.push_unavailable: Notifications are not set up on this server.

auth.signInBody: Use the passkey saved on this device (Face ID, Touch ID or your device code).
auth.setupBody: This one-time link makes you the administrator. Choose a display name and create a passkey.
auth.inviteBody: Join “{{household}}” as {{role}}. Create a passkey to continue.
auth.inviteSignedIn: You're signed in as {{name}}. Add this household to your account?
auth.recoverBody: This link lets you create a new passkey for your existing account.
auth.iosNote: On iPhone: open this link in Safari, save the passkey to iCloud Keychain, then add the app to your Home Screen and sign in there with the same passkey.
auth.noLink: This page needs the full link you received. Ask for a new one if it doesn't work.
auth.linkInvalid: This link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.noHouseholdBody: Your account isn't part of any active household. Ask an owner to invite you.

household.title: Household
household.inviteEmailHint: If email is configured, the link is also emailed. Otherwise copy or share it.
household.recoveryReady: Recovery link (valid 2 days, single use). Send it only to this person.
household.name: Name

admin.title: Admin
admin.name: Household name
admin.privacy: You see households' metadata only — never their transactions or amounts.

ledger.title: Transactions
ledger.emptyBody: Import a bank file or add a transaction by hand.
ledger.similarPrompt_one: {{count}} more uncategorized transaction has the same description. Categorize it too?
ledger.similarPrompt_other: {{count}} more uncategorized transactions have the same description. Categorize them too?
ledger.todoDismiss: Hide until something new comes up

split.title: Split transaction
split.mustMatch: Lines must add up exactly to the transaction amount.
split.uploadHint: PDF, Excel or CSV from the card company. Its charges become the split lines.
split.statementSkipped_one: {{count}} row in the file couldn't be read and is not included. Check the file or add it by hand.
split.statementSkipped_other: {{count}} rows in the file couldn't be read and are not included. Check the file or add them by hand.
split.aiFilled_one: AI suggested a category for {{count}} business. Check it before saving.
split.aiFilled_other: AI suggested categories for {{count}} businesses. Check them before saving.
split.totalMismatch: The charges read from the PDF don't add up to the statement total. Check the lines against the statement.
split.learn: Remember these businesses' categories for next time

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.name: Name
accounts.varianceHelp: Latest known balance minus (opening balance + all transactions up to that date). Non-zero means missing or extra transactions.
accounts.emptyBody: Add your checking account to start.
accounts.investmentHint: The value moves with the market, so update it by hand with “Set balance” (e.g. once a month). Categorize money you move here as “Savings & investments”: it then isn't counted as spending.
accounts.archivedToast: The account has transactions, so it was archived.

categories.title: Categories & rules
categories.hideUnusedBody: These categories have no transactions, budgets, plans or rules of your own. Untick any you want to keep. Hidden categories are no longer assigned automatically on import or offered in pickers. Nothing is deleted; use “Show hidden” to restore one.
categories.name: Name
categories.isDebtHint: Tick for loan and mortgage payments. They count toward the debt load in the health score.
categories.ruleHelp: Rules run on every import. Yours win over learned, AI and built-in rules; longer text wins within the same kind.
categories.archivedToast: The category is in use, so it was archived.

import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Upload the statement you downloaded from your bank. The file is read on this device; only the transactions are sent.
import.whichAccount: Which account is this file from?
import.whichAccountBody: We couldn't tell the account from the file. Pick it, or create a new one.
import.whichAccountBank: This looks like a {{bank}} file, but we couldn't tell which account. Pick it, or create a new one.
import.orCreate: Or create a new checking account
import.drop: or drop an .xlsx, .xls or .csv file here
import.accepted: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV, up to 5 MB
import.maskHint: The file is for an account ending in {{mask}}.
import.maskMismatch: The file's account ends in {{mask}}, which differs from the selected account.
import.mapBody: We couldn't recognize this layout. Tell us which column holds what — we'll remember it for this account.
import.mappingInvalid: Map at least the date, the description and either an amount or debit + credit.
import.profileUsed: Using the column mapping saved for this account.
import.balanceMismatch: The running balance in the file doesn't add up. The transactions will still be imported — check the closing balance afterwards.
import.doneBody: {{inserted}} new, {{duplicates}} already imported, {{merged}} merged with manual entries, {{errors}} skipped.

errorCodes.amount_invalid: Invalid amount (needs exactly one of credit/debit)

import.undoConfirm: Remove the {{count}} transactions added by this import? Manual entries that were merged return to how they were.

fileErrors.not_card: This isn't a card statement we recognize (Isracard, American Express, Max or Cal).
fileErrors.card_file: This is a credit-card statement. Card imports aren't supported yet: import your bank account file, where the monthly card charge appears.
fileErrors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB.
fileErrors.unsupported_file: This file can't be read. Export it again from the bank as Excel or CSV.
fileErrors.no_rows: No transactions were found in the file.
fileErrors.pdf_unreadable: This PDF can't be read (it may be locked or a scanned image). Download the statement again from the card company's website.
fileErrors.pdf_no_table: No charges table was found in this PDF. Isracard and American Express statements are supported; for other cards use Excel or CSV.

budget.title: Budget
budget.noDataYet: No data for this month yet — import a statement to see your pace.

pace.ahead: Spending faster than the month is passing
pace.under: Spending slower than the month is passing
pace.on_pace: Spending in step with the month

budget.allocationHelp: Total monthly budgets compared with average monthly income over the last 3 complete months.
budget.unsplitBanner: {{amount}} in card charges this month isn't split into categories yet.
budget.appliesFrom: Applies from {{month}} onward; earlier months keep their limits.
budget.explainStatusBody: Over: spent more than the limit. Watch (variable categories): used ≥ 90 % of the limit, or ≥ 50 % while ahead of the month by more than 10 points. Otherwise on pace.
budget.explainTotals: Budgeted = sum of limits. Spent = spending in budgeted categories (refunds reduce it). Pace compares % of budget spent with % of the month elapsed (± 5 points).
budget.onceHint: Only for {{month}}; other months keep their usual budget.
budget.howItWorks: Pick a category and an amount. “Every month” repeats from this month on until you change it; “Only this month” is a one-off limit (holidays, a big purchase) that replaces the usual one for that month. Spending is tracked against it as transactions come in.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.recurringHint_one: 1 active recurring payment is counted automatically. Next due:
forecast.recurringHint_other: {{count}} active recurring payments are counted automatically. Next due:
forecast.recurringEmpty: No recurring payments yet. Add them under Recurring and they are included automatically.
forecast.stale: Your data is more than a month old — import a recent statement.
forecast.belowZero: Your balance is expected to go below zero.
forecast.belowBuffer: Your balance is expected to drop below your safety cushion.
forecast.cushionHint: The minimum balance you want to keep at all times. The forecast warns you when the projected lowest balance drops below it. At 0 it only warns below zero.
forecast.noAccount: Mark an account as “Include in the forecast” to see a forecast.
forecast.chart: Projected balance to the end of next month
forecast.explainTitle: How the month-end figure is calculated
forecast.explainFormula: Start balance (as of the data date) + expected income + recurring payments + card charges + planned items + known transactions since then − estimated day-to-day spending = expected balance at month end.
forecast.lowBaseline: Not enough history to estimate day-to-day spending yet; it's counted as zero.

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.subtitle: Next 45 days of expected payments, income and planned items, with the projected balance.
upcoming.empty: Nothing expected in the next 45 days.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.suggestedBody: These look recurring. Confirm to track them, or dismiss.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.matchHint: Used to recognise the payment in imported statements. Card charges with no text match any card charge on the account.
recurring.estimateHelp: Estimate = average of the last 3 matched charges.
recurring.deleteConfirm: Delete this recurring item? Linked transactions stay.

planned.title: One-time planned items
planned.name: What
planned.oneTimeHint: A single expected income or expense (a gift, a refund). Regular payments are managed under Recurring and are already in the forecast.
planned.twin: This looks like the recurring payment “{{name}}”, which the forecast already counts. Add it only if it is an extra payment.
planned.cardHint: Paid by card: added to that card's next charge.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.latestData: Latest data: {{month}}. Import a newer statement to see this month.

usual.title: Your usual month
usual.whereItGoes: Where it usually goes: tap a part of the bar
usual.unassigned: {{amount}} a month isn't in a category yet (uncategorized or unsplit card charges). Categorize it for a fuller picture.
usual.notYet: After your first complete month of data, this shows what you usually spend per category.

onboarding.title: Let's get started
onboarding.body: Upload your bank statement, or first take a quick tour of the app on demo data.
onboarding.sampleBody: A fictional household with 6 months of data. You can clear it in one tap.
onboarding.clearConfirm: Remove all sample data? Your categories and settings are kept.
onboarding.needOwner: Ask an owner of this household to upload the first statement.

health.title: Health score
health.noScoreBody: The score needs at least two of: income history, a liquid account, budgets, or a goal with a date.

inputs.savings: Left over ÷ income, last 3 complete months
inputs.debt: Debt payments ÷ income, last 3 complete months
inputs.cushion: Months of spending covered by available money
inputs.budget: Budgeted categories within their limit this month

health.formula: Each part turns a measured value into 0–100 points along a published curve. The score is the weighted average of the parts that have data (weights 25 / 20 / 25 / 15 / 15).

recs.spend_less: Spend {{amount}} less per month (5 % of income)
recs.fix_budget: Bring over-limit categories back to their limits ({{amount}} over)
recs.add_cushion: Add one month of spending ({{amount}}) to available money
recs.goals_on_track: Put goals back on track ({{amount}} more per month)
recs.reduce_debt: Reduce debt payments by 10 % ({{amount}} per month)

insights.stale_data: Your latest data is from {{date}}. Import a recent statement.
insights.no_forecast_account: Mark your main account “Include in the forecast” to see where the month is heading.
insights.low_point_negative: Your balance may drop to {{amount}} on {{date}}.
insights.low_point_buffer: Your balance may drop to {{amount}} on {{date}}, below your {{buffer}} safety cushion.
insights.card_unsplit: {{amount}} in card charges isn't split into categories
insights.category_spike: {{category}} is heading for {{amount}} — well above the usual {{avg}}
insights.pace_more: You've spent {{pct}} more than last month by day {{day}}
insights.pace_less: You've spent {{pct}} less than last month by day {{day}}
insights.goal_behind: {{goal}} is behind — {{amount}} a month gets it back on track
insights.savings_good: You saved {{pct}} of your income in {{month}}
insights.under_budget: You stayed within your budget in {{month}}

goals.title: Goals
goals.name: Name
goals.allocationLine: {{committed}} per month of an average {{surplus}} left over
goals.noSurplus: No monthly surplus in the last 3 months.
goals.empty: No goals yet. Add one to start tracking.
goals.deleteConfirm: Delete this goal and its contributions?
goals.explain: Required per month = remaining ÷ months left (rounded up). On track = saved ≥ the straight-line target for today − 5 % of the goal.

data.title: Data control
data.resetBody: Removes every transaction, account, budget, goal and import. Categories return to the defaults.
data.deleteBody: Deletes the household and all of its data for every member. This cannot be undone.
data.typeName: Type the household name to confirm: {{name}}

review.title: Monthly review
review.dueBody: The month has ended. Take a few minutes to see how it went and what to do next.
review.ruleBased: Written by rules from your numbers.

summary.negative: In {{month}} you spent {{net}} more than came in.

income.up: Income rose {{pct}} compared with the month before.
income.down: Income fell {{pct}} compared with the month before.
income.flat: Income was about the same as the month before.

spending.up_over: Spending rose {{pct}}, and {{count}} budget categories went over their limit.
spending.up_under: Spending rose {{pct}}, but budgeted categories stayed within their limits.
spending.down_over: Spending fell {{pct}}, though {{count}} budget categories went over.
spending.flat_over: Spending was steady; {{count}} budget categories went over.
spending.flat_under: Spending was steady and within budget.

budget.none: No budgets set yet — setting a few limits makes this chapter useful.
budget.all_within: Every budgeted category stayed within its limit.

goals.all_on_track: All dated goals are on track.

cashflow.no_income: No income was recorded this month.
cashflow.strong: You kept {{pct}} of your income — a strong month.
cashflow.negative: Spending exceeded income by {{pct}} of income.

c.wrapup: Here are the steps that would improve your score the most.

h.no_score: Not enough data for a score yet — keep importing statements.
h.excellent_down: Still excellent ({{score}}), a little below last month.
h.fair_up: A fair month, moving in the right direction ({{score}}).
h.fair_down: A fair month ({{score}}) that slipped a little.

win.spending_down: Spending dropped {{pct}} from the month before.
win.budgets: Every budgeted category stayed within its limit.

focus.spending_up: Spending rose {{pct}} from the month before.
focus.low_savings: You kept only {{pct}} of your income.
focus.top_cat: {{name}} was your biggest expense ({{pct}} of spending).

act.over: Plan {{name}} to stay under {{limit}} next month.
act.set_budget: Set budgets for your top spending categories.
act.next_review: Import next month's statements and review it when the month ends.

ai.title: AI assistance
ai.unavailable: AI isn't configured on this server. Everything works without it.
ai.offBody: Optional. Off by default. When on, an AI model can suggest categories and write review commentary. Every number stays rule-based.
ai.onlyOwner: Only an owner can turn AI on.
ai.consentTitle: Turn on AI for this household?
ai.trains: Does the provider train on your data?
ai.trainsYes: Yes — the provider may use inputs to improve its products.
ai.trainsNo: No — inputs are not used for training.
ai.sent1: Merchant names from bank descriptions, with long numbers (phones, accounts, cards) and e-mail addresses removed
ai.sent2: Whether money went in or out, and the amount rounded to ₪10
ai.sent4: For reviews: monthly totals, category totals, budget lines, goal names and progress, your health score
ai.notSent1: Bank files, account numbers, references or notes
ai.notSent3: Names or e-mails of household members
ai.limits: Daily limits: {{categorize}} categorization requests and {{review}} review requests per household.
ai.disclaimer: General information only, not financial advice.
ai.failed: AI couldn't write commentary right now; the rule-based text is shown.
ai.enableHint: Enable AI in Settings to get written commentary.
ai.suggestBody: Nothing is saved until you approve. Unsure guesses start unticked. Approved merchants are remembered.
ai.suggestCount_one: Let AI suggest a category for {{count}} uncategorized transaction
ai.suggestCount_other: Let AI suggest categories for {{count}} uncategorized transactions
ai.partial: AI answered only part of the list. Try again later for the rest.
ai.noSuggestions: No suggestions — nothing eligible to categorize.
ai.skippedGeneric_one: {{count}} transfer or payment-app suggestion was skipped: categorize those one by one
ai.skippedGeneric_other: {{count}} transfer or payment-app suggestions were skipped: categorize those one by one

security.title: Sign-in & devices
security.addPasskey: Add a passkey on this device
security.onlyPasskey: This is your only passkey; add another before removing it.

tour.later: Done. Tap the ⓘ next to any page title to tour that page.

main.title: The main pages are done
main.body: Continue to the other pages, or finish and take each page’s tour later with its ⓘ button.

page.title: That’s this page
page.body: Tour more pages, or finish here.

welcome.title: A quick tour
welcome.body: We’ll point at the buttons and cards you’ll use most, on demo data — your own data isn’t touched. Next and Back move; Esc leaves.

nav.title: Main pages
nav.body: Switch between your main pages here. On a phone you choose which pages sit in this bar (Settings); the rest are under More.

add.title: Add a transaction
add.body: Record cash or anything not in a bank file yet: amount, description, date and category. Add it right after paying so the month stays accurate.

reviewDue.title: Monthly review is ready
reviewDue.body: When a month ends, this card invites you to a short guided review of it. Open it now, or dismiss it.

monthSummary.title: This month so far
monthSummary.body: Income, expenses and what’s left this month, with what to expect by month end. A quick check that the month is on track.

forecastCard.title: Month-end forecast
forecastCard.body: Where your balance should land at month end, and its lowest point on the way. Tap the title for the full forecast.

search.title: Search
search.body: Find transactions by shop, a word from the description, a note — or a category name, such as “Groceries”.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Narrow the list by dates, account, category or “uncategorized only”. The number shows how many filters are on.

todo.title: Needs attention
todo.body: Transactions without a category collect here. “Show” lists them so you can sort them; with AI turned on, “Suggest categories with AI” does it in one go.

unsplit.title: Unsplit card payment
unsplit.body: A credit-card bill arrives as one big payment. Split it into categories — by hand, or upload the card statement to split it automatically — so the budget sees the real spending.

txRow.title: Change a category
txRow.body: Tap a transaction to fix its category, add a note or split it. After a change you’re offered to apply it to similar transactions too, or always.

budgetAdd.title: Add a budget
budgetAdd.body: Set a spending limit for a category. Monthly repeats every month; one-time covers a single month, like a holiday.

budgetTop.title: Your budgets
budgetTop.body: Each card shows the 3 categories most worth a look. “See all” opens the full list.

upcomingRecurring.title: Upcoming and Recurring
upcomingRecurring.body: Upcoming lists the next payments and income by date. This button jumps to Recurring, where you manage the fixed items behind them.

plan.title: Plan an expense
plan.body: Add a one-off future expense, like the car’s annual test, so the forecast counts it before it happens.

recurring.title: Recurring totals
recurring.body: What all your fixed payments cost per month and per year. Add, pause or edit items below; Upcoming shows when each one is due.

forecastEom.title: Expected month end
forecastEom.body: The balance expected at month end and the lowest point before it. Use it to see whether a big expense fits this month.

cushion.title: Safety cushion
cushion.body: The minimum balance you want to keep at all times. Set it here; the forecast warns you when the projected lowest point drops below it.

trendsRange.title: Choose a period
trendsRange.body: One control sets the period for every chart on this page: a preset, your own dates, or step back and forward.

goals.title: A savings goal
goals.body: Each goal shows what’s saved, what’s left and the monthly amount needed to reach it on time.

categoryAdd.title: Add a category
categoryAdd.body: Pick a ready-made category from the list, or create your own with any name.

hideUnused.title: Hide unused
hideUnused.body: Hides categories you’ve never used so pickers stay short. You can show them again any time.

accountAdd.title: Add an account
accountAdd.body: Add a bank account, savings or a credit card. Pick its bank from the list so imports and the bank link work.

bankLink.title: Open your bank
bankLink.body: Opens the bank’s website, to download the latest statement for import.

importAccount.title: Which account?
importAccount.body: Leave it on “Detect from the file”: the account is recognized from the file. Pick one yourself only if a file isn’t matched.

reviewStart.title: Start a review
reviewStart.body: Walk through last month in a few short chapters: income, spending, budget, goals and cash flow.

reviewFinal.title: Final summary
reviewFinal.body: The wrap-up: the month in one line, the key numbers, wins, a watch list and next steps.

reviewAi.title: AI interpretation
reviewAi.body: This text is rule-based. With AI turned on in Settings, “Interpret with AI” adds a separate, clearly labelled interpretation.

navBar.title: Choose your bottom bar
navBar.body: Pick the three pages that sit in the phone’s bottom bar. Everything else stays under More.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Your own nudges, e.g. to import a fresh statement weekly or log today’s spending. They pop up here and, if you allow notifications, on this phone.
